dashboard.title: Dashboard example
dashboard.description: A full-page dashboard built only from Tsunami components: stats, a chart and a table of recent orders, with the sidebar and the top bar.

orders.title: Orders example
orders.description: A full-page orders list built from Tsunami components: a data table with filters, a date range and bulk actions on the selected rows.

settings.title: Settings example
settings.description: A full-page settings flow built from Tsunami components: a multi-step form with a stepper, validation and a review step.

login.title: Login example
login.description: A full-page sign-in built from Tsunami components: email and password, then a one-time code, with the OTP input and a light and dark theme switch.
